messages:
deploy-bot: Promo attempt for release/2026-02-14 blocked: ci-staging artifact restore failed (cache restore checksum mismatch). Auto-promo paused. https://ci.internal/runs/11077

harper: which artifact is failing?

deploy-bot: redwood-sdk-1.2.7-py3-none-any.whl expected sha256=4b2f6a9c got=93e1d2b7

devon: tail of fetch logs:
```
GET /cache/mirror/redwood-sdk-1.2.7.whl 200
stream copy failed: checksum mismatch
expected=4b2f6a9c... actual=93e1d2b7...
remote storage returned truncated object
```

ops-kai: mirror-sync reported multipart finalize failures for prefix redwood-sdk/1.2.7 around 01:10 UTC. Likely incomplete multipart or network blip.

pm-ina: change window is 50m total, ~28m left. We should avoid slipping the release if possible. Options: (A) reupload mirror now and retry (B) pin to verified digest + promote and follow up with rebuild. Thoughts?

harper: prefer pin+promote unless reupload is trivial. Can you find last-good digest?

devon: found metadata: s3://prod-mirror/redwood-sdk/1.2.7/sha256.txt -> 4b2f6a9c. Also archived copy at longterm://artifacts/4b2f6a9c.whl

ops-kai: if we pin we must create incident INC-2026-041, attach rollback instructions (how to unpin and re-promote), and run a quick wheel-inspect against source tree hash. Also mark release notes with a short line about the pin.

harper: running dry-run pin now:
```bash
deploybot promote --release release/2026-02-14 --artifact redwood-sdk==1.2.7 --digest 4b2f6a9c --force-pin --dry-run
```

harper: dry-run clean, no manifest mismatch. executing promote.

deploy-bot: Promote accepted: release pinned to digest 4b2f6a9c. Auto-promo resumed. Promotion complete.

pm-ina: created INC-2026-041 assigned to infra-blobstore. Release notes updated: "Pinned redwood-sdk 1.2.7 to verified artifact digest due to cache restore checksum mismatch; rebuild+reupload scheduled."

devon: will kick off an uploader audit and post findings in #eng-infra. Marking release flow resolved; incident remains open for RCA.
